name: Maidie
source:
Maidie is the guild mistress at Lynton. Cheery and irreverent, she's an incorrigible lover of gossip. She's often thinking up get rich quick schemes, and has a particular interest in maids.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1466680/Sakura_MMO_Extra/]Steam[/url]]
